t: The Turbo TX multi-purpose screw trade pack offers a comprehensive range of fastenings for professional tradespeople. These zinc-plated screws are ideal for carpentry, joinery, and general building applications, providing secure fixing in wood, plastic, masonry, and thin sheet metal. Featuring a TX recess, driving capability is improved, while the razor-sharp slash tip ensures an ultra-quick start with no pre-drilling required in wood. A deep, sharp thread cuts cleanly through timber, facilitating fast, continuous insertion. The double self-countersunk head removes the need to counterbore, streamlining work on site. Heat-treated carbon steel construction enhances strength, reducing the risk of snapping during installation.
b: Double Self-Countersunk Removing the Need to Counterbore
Deep, Sharp, Single Thread for Cutting Cleanly through Wood
Rifled Shank Reduces Splitting & Allows Close to the Edge Driving
Contains 1400 Pieces For Varied Trade Use
